summary: Every gen_toks value (256, 512, 1024, 2048) produced one identical sequential-order CIS2_REF digest on 5 builds spanning 2 ISA classes + CUDA: hq g++ AVX2+FMA (host C), hq CUDA sm_61, w2 g++ AVX2+FMA Broadwell (host D), w3 g++ SSE4.2 N4020 (host A), w4 g++ SSE4.2 N4020C (host H); 16-token sanity row = pinned d8274305 on every run.
